items.title: Measuring performance using profiling tools (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Measuring performance using profiling tools (PDF 70, printed 66), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Profiling tools program ke mukhtalif functions ka chalne ka waqt (execution time) aur memory ka istemal record karte hain. Python is kaam ke liye cProfile aur timeit jaise modules deta hai. Yeh tools reports banate hain jo dikhati hain ke code ke kaun se hisse sust hain ya zyada wasail lete hain (Figure 5.3). Performance napne se pata chalta hai ke pehle kis hisse ko optimise karna hai.

blocks.alt: Profiler report ka table: oopar ki row mein unwan Call Count, Time, Cumulative Time (do columns par) aur Description chhape hain. Rows: process_data 10, 2.500, 2.500, Bottleneck; read_file 1, 2.400, 2.400, Bottleneck (laal row, khatre ka nishan); analyze_results 10, 0.100, 0.100. Nuqta-daar teer aag par rakhe magnifying glass tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: Bottlenecks ko numayan karta profiling output (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Table mein har function ke calls ki ginti aur us par laga waqt hai. Sab se zyada waqt lene wale functions bottleneck hain; laal row read_file khaas taur par numayan hai.

items: cProfile aur timeit waqt napte hain.
Report dikhati hai kaun sa function sab se zyada waqt leta hai.
